Calibre 9.17 is now available, bringing faster ebook conversion speeds for formats like MOBI and AZW3, along with native JPEG XL image reading during conversions.

This release also introduces accessibility updates respecting system motion settings, automated checks for book accessibility labels, and regression fixes for PDF and EPUB 3 conversions from v9.16.
